newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway stock index drops, fokus on banks.
newsitem.headline: Norway stock index drops, fokus on banks.

text.p: The Oslo stock index fell with other European bourses on Friday following an unexpected jump in the core U.S. inflation rate for March.
Oslo's Total index closed 0.68 percent lower at 1,063.32 points in thin turnover of 687 million crowns.
Trading was cautious ahead of the release of the U.S. inflation figures in the afternoon, and the index dropped when the data become known.
Dealers said the market would continue to watch the United States for signs of further rises in U.S. interest rates.
Trade was relatively brisk in banking shares amid efforts to consolidate in the overbanked Norwegian financial market.
Fokus Bank paradoxically rose three percent to 69 crowns after mortgage lender BNbank seemed to prefer a takeover bid by DnB to one by Fokus.
BNbank said the DnB cash offer appeared to be good and said it was postponing possible merger talks with rival bidder Fokus.
"If Fokus loses the battle it will be easier for another bank to take over Fokus," one dealer said to explain the interest in Fokus shares. It was the most traded share at 96 million crowns.
